terms-page.title: Terms & Conditions
terms-page.description: RAISEUP operates through its digital platform, offering training programs and courses accessible to learners globally. These Terms and Conditions apply universally to all training services provided via the official RAISEUP website and course listings.

list1.title: 1. Payment Terms
content: 100% of the payment must be completed within 15 days upon receipt of the invoice.
Payments can be made by cash, credit/debit card, cheque, or bank transfer.
We accept online payments using VISA and MasterCard in AED (or other supported currencies).
If you make a payment through our website, your payment details will be securely processed via a trusted payment provider.
Prices displayed on the RAISEUP website do not include taxes, transfer fees, or withholding charges – such costs must be covered by the client where applicable.
Minors under 18 are not allowed to register, make payments, or use the platform.
Cardholders should retain copies of all transactions and abide by the merchant's policies and rules.

content.1st: All cancellations or postponements must be submitted in written form.
content.2nd: In case of cancellation or postponement by the client:
ul: No cancellation fee if the request is made at least 14 days before the course start date.
Postponements made less than 14 days before the course start date will incur a 50% charge of the total course fee.
Cancellations made less than 14 days before the course start date will incur a 100% cancellation fee.
In these cases, a credit note may be issued for the full amount, valid for use within 12 months on any RAISEUP course.
content.3rd: In case of cancellation or postponement by RAISEUP:
ul2: A 100% refund will be issued or a credit note offered (valid for 12 months), based on the client's preference.

list3.title: 3. Complaints and Refunds Procedure
list3.1st: a. RAISEUP recognizes the following as valid complaints:
ul: Major discrepancies between advertised and actual course duration.
list3.2nd: b. All complaints must be submitted in writing with sufficient detail
list3.3rd: c. Send complaints or inquiries to: support@raiseup.com
list3.4th: d. RAISEUP will respond within 7 days of receiving a complaint.

list4.title: 4. Trainer and Location Selection
list4.1st: The trainer and training location are selected at RAISEUP’s discretion.
list4.2nd: We aim for continuity, but RAISEUP reserves the right to change the trainer or location before the course starts if necessary.

list5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
list5.1st: All training materials, designs, and content are the intellectual property of RAISEUP or its instructors.
list5.2nd: No materials may be copied, shared, or reproduced without prior written consent.

list6.title: 6. Health and Safety
list6.1st: All participants must comply with the Health & Safety Policy of RAISEUP or the training venue if delivered on-site or through a partner location.

list7.title: 7. Force Majeure
list7.1st: RAISEUP shall not be liable for any failure or delay in service delivery due to events beyond its reasonable control, including but not limited to:
list7.2nd: In such cases, RAISEUP will attempt to reschedule or provide an alternative. These disruptions will not be considered a breach, and no refund is guaranteed.

terms-page.footer: These terms apply across all RAISEUP training services and are subject to the applicable laws in the countries where users or services are located.

faqs-page.title: FAQ’S
faqs-page.description: Got a question? Find quick answers to the most common ones here.

faqs.title: Q1: What programs does RaiseUp offer?
faqs.description: RaiseUp provides a wide range of IT and Business training programs designed to develop both technical and professional skills. Our programs focus on career-oriented learning, combining practical training with internationally recognized certifications to prepare individuals and organizations for real-world success.

faqs.title: Q2: Are RaiseUp programs internationally recognized?
faqs.description: Yes. RaiseUp is an Official Cisco NetAcad Partner, and our certifications are respected by employers worldwide.

faqs.title: Q3: Can I study online with RaiseUp?
faqs.description: Absolutely! We provide onsite and live online programs, both including hands-on labs and guided practice.

faqs.title: Q4: Who can benefit from RaiseUp training?
faqs.description: We serve students, graduates, job seekers, career shifters, professionals, freelancers, and corporate teams looking to enhance their skills.

faqs.title: Q5: Where are RaiseUp branches located?
faqs.description: Our headquarters is in Dubai, UAE, with branches in Riyadh (KSA) and Cairo (Egypt).

PolicyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PolicyPage.subtitle: RAISEUP provides its training programs through a digital platform, requiring users to share certain personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how such data is collected, used, and protected when accessing services via our official website.

information.title: 1.Information We Collect:
information.subtitle: Contact us
information.description: When you register for RAISEUP services or interact with our platform, we may collect personal information including:
information.additional: We may also collect technical information such as device type, browser type, IP address, and usage statistics to improve our platform's performance and user experience.

usage.title: 2.How We Use Your Information:
list: Provide access to our training programs and manage your progress
Communicate with you about courses, updates, and promotional content
Customize your learning experience and provide personalized recommendations
Process payments and issue certificates upon completion
Improve our services and develop new educational content
Comply with legal obligations and protect against misuse

sharing.title: 3.Sharing Your Information:
sharing.description: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. However, we may share your data with trusted service providers who assist us in operating our platform, such as:
list: Cloud hosting and technical support services
sharing.additional: These partners are contractually bound to protect your data and use it only for the purposes we specify. We may also disclose your information if required by law or to protect our rights and the safety of our users.

rights.title: 4.Your Rights:
rights.description: As a user of RAISEUP, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
list: The right to access the personal information we hold about you
The right to request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
The right to request deletion of your data, subject to legal and contractual obligations
The right to object to or restrict processing of your personal information
The right to data portability (receiving your data in a structured format)
The right to withdraw consent for marketing communications
The right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority
rights.additional: To exercise any of these rights, such as data portability, please contact us using the information provided below.

contact.title: 5.Contact Us:
contact.description: If you have any questions, concerns, or requests related to this Privacy Policy or your personal data, please contact our support team. We are committed to addressing your inquiries promptly and transparently.

consent.title: By continuing, you agree to our Privacy Policy.

Blog.subtitle: Insights and updates from our team

firstSection.title: Remote Work Research
firstSection.content: Remote working might not only be feasible but beneficial. Stanford University found that remote employees were 13% more productive, with absolutely "no difference in the effectiveness, performance ratings, or promotions".

secondSection.title: Understanding Remote Work
secondSection.content:
Introduction
Remote work is a flexible work style where you work outside a traditional office environment. It comes in many forms depending on a company's size, stage, and philosophy.
At one extreme, employees may work from home occasionally. At the other end of the spectrum, fully remote employees stop commuting entirely and work whenever and wherever they're most productive.
This article outlines how and why people work remotely, how to find a remote job, common misconceptions about remote work and the different types of remote companies.
